nodes.label: Debug Build
nodes.description: Building Node.js with --debug flag produces node_g binary with DCHECKs enabled

nodes.label: AddressSanitizer Build
nodes.description: Building Node.js with --enable-asan for memory error detection

nodes.label: Ninja Build System
nodes.description: Using --ninja flag with configure for faster incremental builds

nodes.label: Node.js Repository Structure
nodes.description: Standard layout: src/ (C++), lib/ (JS), deps/ (V8, libuv, openssl), test/, doc/, tools/, benchmark/

nodes.label: Pull Request Process
nodes.description: Contributing to Node.js: fork, branch, commit format 'subsystem: description', PR with tests

nodes.label: Semver Labels
nodes.description: semver-major (breaking), semver-minor (feature), semver-patch (fix) labels for PRs

nodes.label: Crypto Module Architecture
nodes.description: Three-layer architecture: JS (lib/crypto.js) -> C++ bindings (src/crypto/) -> OpenSSL (EVP_*, RAND_*, X509_*)

nodes.label: Crypto Thread Pool Operations
nodes.description: pbkdf2, scrypt, randomBytes (async), generateKeyPair use libuv thread pool; createHash, createCipher run on main thread

nodes.label: Crypto Hash C++ Implementation
nodes.description: Hash operations wrap OpenSSL EVP_DigestUpdate/EVP_DigestFinal_ex via src/crypto/crypto_hash.cc

nodes.label: Crypto Cipher C++ Implementation
nodes.description: Cipher operations wrap EVP_CipherUpdate via src/crypto/crypto_cipher.cc, supports AEAD modes with auth tags

nodes.label: Native Debugging Tools
nodes.description: GDB and LLDB for debugging Node.js C++ addons and core, with V8-specific helper commands

nodes.label: Core Dump Debugging
nodes.description: Enabling and analyzing core dumps with GDB/LLDB for crash investigation

nodes.label: Remote Debugging
nodes.description: Remote debugging with gdbserver and lldb-server for remote target machines

nodes.label: API Documentation Conventions
nodes.description: Rules for doc/api/*.md files: YAML metadata blocks, stability indicators, link reference ordering, dual CJS/ESM examples

nodes.label: Link Reference Ordering
nodes.description: Strict ASCII lexical ordering for link references at bottom of markdown files, enforced by make lint-md

nodes.label: Error Documentation
nodes.description: New error codes require alphabetical entries in both lib/internal/errors.js and doc/api/errors.md

nodes.label: FS Module Architecture
nodes.description: Three-layer architecture: JS (lib/fs.js) -> C++ bindings (src/node_file.cc) -> libuv thread pool -> system calls

nodes.label: FS Async vs Sync Operations
nodes.description: Async fs operations use thread pool via FSReqCallback/FSReqPromise; sync operations block the event loop

nodes.label: File Descriptors
nodes.description: fs.open returns integer file descriptors; must be closed to prevent leaks; used for read/write at offset

nodes.label: libuv Async I/O
nodes.description: Cross-platform async I/O using epoll (Linux), kqueue (macOS), IOCP (Windows), event ports (SunOS)

nodes.label: libuv Handles and Requests
nodes.description: Handles are long-lived resource representations (TCP, UDP, Timer, etc.); Requests are short-lived operations (connect, write, FS, DNS)

nodes.label: libuv Stream Backpressure
nodes.description: Backpressure via socket.pause()/resume() mapping to uv_read_stop()/uv_read_start(); write drain events for write backpressure

nodes.label: libuv Async Notification
nodes.description: uv_async_t for cross-thread signaling; used for worker thread communication and N-API async callbacks

nodes.label: Event Loop Phases
nodes.description: Six phases: timers -> pending callbacks -> idle/prepare -> poll -> check -> close callbacks

nodes.label: Microtasks and nextTick
nodes.description: process.nextTick() and Promise callbacks execute between phases; recursive nextTick starves I/O

nodes.label: nextTick Starvation
nodes.description: Recursive process.nextTick prevents I/O callbacks from executing; use setImmediate for recursion instead

nodes.label: Thread Pool Configuration
nodes.description: Default 4 threads, configurable via UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE env var (max 1024), must be set before Node.js starts

nodes.label: Thread Pool Operations
nodes.description: fs operations (except fs.watch), dns.lookup (not dns.resolve), some crypto ops, zlib, custom addons via uv_queue_work

nodes.label: Thread Pool Starvation
nodes.description: When all 4 default threads are busy, new operations queue; dns.lookup is a canary for saturation

nodes.label: V8 Heap Memory Layout
nodes.description: Process memory: V8 Heap (New/Old/Large Object/Code spaces), V8 External Memory, Native Memory, Stack

nodes.label: Heap Snapshots
nodes.description: Taking and comparing heap snapshots via v8.writeHeapSnapshot() or inspector API; key terms: shallow size, retained size, distance, retainers

nodes.label: Memory Leak Detection
nodes.description: Monitoring heap growth over time, using async_hooks to track thread pool operations, comparing heap snapshots

nodes.label: N-API ABI Stability
nodes.description: N-API provides ABI-stable API for native addons; code compatible across Node.js versions without recompilation

nodes.label: N-API Versions
nodes.description: Versioned features: v1 (8.0.0 core), v3 (BigInt), v5 (Date/finalization), v8 (type tagging), v9 (extended Buffer)

nodes.label: N-API AsyncWorker Pattern
nodes.description: AsyncWorker for blocking operations on thread pool with Execute() and Complete() callbacks, returns Promise

nodes.label: N-API ThreadSafeFunction
nodes.description: Calling JavaScript from any thread via napi_threadsafe_function; queues JS callbacks on main thread

nodes.label: N-API Object Wrapping
nodes.description: Wrapping C/C++ objects as JavaScript objects using napi_wrap/napi_unwrap with destructor callbacks

nodes.label: N-API Instance Data
nodes.description: Per-addon-instance data storage for worker thread safety via napi_set_instance_data/napi_get_instance_data

nodes.label: Native Memory Management
nodes.description: Memory strategies: stack vs heap allocation, smart pointers (unique_ptr, shared_ptr), RAII patterns for native addons

nodes.label: Native Buffer Handling
nodes.description: Creating buffers: Node.js allocated (Buffer::New), copied (Buffer::Copy), external with finalizer; must keep references to prevent GC

nodes.label: External Memory Tracking
nodes.description: Napi::MemoryManagement::AdjustExternalMemory to tell V8 about native allocations; prevents GC starvation

nodes.label: Native Memory Leak Prevention
nodes.description: Common leaks: forgotten delete, exception paths, reference cycles, ThreadSafeFunction not released, AsyncWorker raw pointers

nodes.label: Net Module Architecture
nodes.description: Three-layer architecture: JS (lib/net.js, lib/dgram.js) -> C++ (TCPWrap, UDPWrap, PipeWrap) -> libuv (uv_tcp_t, uv_udp_t) -> system calls

nodes.label: TCP Server Implementation
nodes.description: Server creates TCP handle, binds, listens; onconnection callback creates Socket wrapper; C++ TCPWrap::OnConnection calls uv_accept

nodes.label: TCP Client Connection
nodes.description: Connect flow: create TCP handle, DNS lookup if needed, TCPConnectWrap request, afterConnect callback sets readable/writable

nodes.label: node-addon-api C++ Wrapper
nodes.description: C++ wrapper around N-API providing idiomatic C++: type conversions, error handling, ObjectWrap, AsyncWorker, ThreadSafeFunction

nodes.label: node-addon-api Error Handling
nodes.description: Two modes: NAPI_CPP_EXCEPTIONS (C++ exceptions) or non-exception mode with env.IsExceptionPending() checks

nodes.label: node-addon-api AsyncWorker
nodes.description: AsyncWorker with Execute() on thread pool, OnOK()/OnError() on main thread; AsyncProgressWorker for progress reporting

nodes.label: Primordials
nodes.description: Frozen copies of JS built-in objects captured before user code runs; protects internal modules from prototype pollution

nodes.label: uncurryThis Pattern
nodes.description: Prototype methods converted to standalone functions where this becomes first argument: arr.push(item) -> ArrayPrototypePush(arr, item)

nodes.label: Safe Classes
nodes.description: SafeMap, SafeSet, SafeWeakMap etc. with frozen/null-prototype chains; SafePromiseAllReturnVoid and SafePromiseAllReturnArrayLike

nodes.label: Unsafe Patterns in Core
nodes.description: for-of iteration, array destructuring, spread operator, RegExp.test, instanceof, generators are unsafe in core code

nodes.label: V8 CPU Profiling
nodes.description: Using --prof flag, processing with --prof-process; * = optimized, ~ = interpreted; flame graphs via 0x, perf, dtrace

nodes.label: V8 Optimization Tracing
nodes.description: --trace-opt for optimization events, --trace-deopt for deoptimization with reasons (not a Smi, wrong map, minus zero, etc.)

nodes.label: Flame Graph Generation
nodes.description: Using 0x tool, Linux perf, or macOS dtrace to generate flame graphs; wide boxes = CPU consumers, plateaus = slow children

nodes.label: PR Review Checklist
nodes.description: Technical review: commit message, scope, tests, documentation, code quality (primordials, validators, errors), build/CI

nodes.label: AI-Generated PR Red Flags
nodes.description: Hallucinated APIs, inconsistent convention adherence, over-engineering, tests testing implementation not behavior, boilerplate responses

nodes.label: Streams Architecture
nodes.description: Four-layer architecture: JS (Readable/Writable/Duplex/Transform) -> C++ (StreamBase, StreamReq) -> libuv streams (uv_stream_t) -> system

nodes.label: StreamBase C++ Interface
nodes.description: StreamBase abstract class: ReadStart/ReadStop/DoWrite/DoShutdown; WriteWrap/ShutdownWrap for operation tracking

nodes.label: Readable Stream Flow
nodes.description: read() -> _read(n) -> C++ ReadStart -> uv_read_start -> epoll/kqueue -> alloc_cb -> read_cb -> OnRead -> Buffer -> push(chunk) -> data event

nodes.label: V8 Generational GC
nodes.description: Generational GC: Scavenger (young gen, semi-space copying) + Mark-Sweep/Mark-Compact (old gen); based on generational hypothesis

nodes.label: V8 Scavenger (Minor GC)
nodes.description: Young generation collection: semi-space copying, objects surviving 2 collections promoted to old space; fast but requires 2x memory

nodes.label: Mark-Sweep (Major GC)
nodes.description: Old generation: mark reachable objects from roots, sweep dead; incremental marking reduces pause times; write barriers track cross-gen refs

nodes.label: Mark-Compact GC
nodes.description: When heap fragmentation is high: mark + compact by moving live objects to eliminate gaps; expensive due to pointer updates

nodes.label: GC Common Pitfalls
nodes.description: Closure memory retention, unintentional global references, timer/event listener leaks; use object pooling for high-allocation scenarios

nodes.label: V8 Hidden Classes (Maps)
nodes.description: V8 creates hidden classes describing object structure; transitions happen on property add/delete; maps describe property offsets

nodes.label: Inline Caching (IC)
nodes.description: V8 caches hidden class and offset for property access; states: uninitialized -> monomorphic -> polymorphic -> megamorphic (>4 maps)

nodes.label: Array Elements Kinds
nodes.description: V8 tracks array element types: PACKED_SMI_ELEMENTS (fastest) -> PACKED_DOUBLE_ELEMENTS -> PACKED_ELEMENTS -> HOLEY_ELEMENTS; transitions only downward

nodes.label: Hidden Class Best Practices
nodes.description: Initialize properties in consistent order, use classes/constructors, avoid delete, keep type stability, avoid dynamic property names

nodes.label: V8 JIT Compilation Pipeline
nodes.description: Parser -> AST -> Ignition (interpreter, bytecode) -> TurboFan (JIT compiler, machine code); profiling triggers tier-up

nodes.label: Type Feedback and Speculation
nodes.description: TurboFan uses type feedback to speculate on types; deoptimization occurs on type mismatch (not a Smi, wrong map, etc.)

nodes.label: Writing Optimizable Code
nodes.description: Type stability, avoid megamorphic call sites, loop optimization, avoid arguments object, prefer rest parameters, avoid object spread in hot loops

nodes.label: V8 Escape Analysis
nodes.description: TurboFan eliminates heap allocations when objects don't escape the function; enables stack allocation

nodes.label: Worker Threads Architecture
nodes.description: Each worker has its own V8 Isolate and event loop; communication via MessagePort/MessageChannel; shared memory via SharedArrayBuffer

nodes.label: Worker Thread Creation
nodes.description: JS Worker class creates C++ WorkerImpl, sets up MessageChannel, StartThread creates uv_thread with new V8 Isolate and Environment

nodes.label: Structured Clone for Messaging
nodes.description: Messages serialized via structured clone: supports numbers, strings, Date, RegExp, Array, Map, Set, Buffer, TypedArray, ArrayBuffer, Error; not functions/symbols

nodes.label: Transfer List (Zero-Copy)
nodes.description: Transfer ArrayBuffer/MessagePort ownership instead of copying; transferred buffer is detached (unusable) in sender
